content.text: No minimum commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall, or volume-cap language exists anywhere in the agreement.

input.quote: During the term of this Agreement, Company agrees to compensate Contractor as set forth in each Statement of Work. Contractor will be compensated on a time and materials.
input.rationale: The agreement imposes no minimum purchase commitment on Clear Capital. Services are engaged "on a task by task basis" under individually negotiated Statements of Work (p0004), and compensation is strictly time and materials as set out in each SOW plus actual out-of-pocket expenses (p0013), i.e. fees are payable only for services actually ordered and performed. Searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "take-or-pay", "guarantee", "volume" and "quota" returned no take-or-pay, minimum-fee, guaranteed-hours or usage-cap provisions, and § 6 permits termination for convenience on fifteen days' notice whenever no SOW is outstanding (p0032). This sits at the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for ordered services only), so no redline is required. We note separately that Contractor may change rates on 30 days' notice under p0014 with no uplift cap — a pricing point outside this rule and addressed, if at all, under the pricing rule rather than here.
